title: Reading a Contract, Policy, or Terms of Service
goal: Read a lease and an app's terms of service closely enough to state what you're actually agreeing to, what conditions apply, and what's buried in the fine print.

questions: If rent is due on the 1st, and a tenant mails a check on the 1st that arrives and is processed on the 4th, is that payment late under §4? Quote the exact phrase that answers this.

A tenant assumes "normal wear and tear" covers minor scuffed paint after a year of living there. Does §6 actually agree? Quote the clause and explain the gap between the tenant's assumption and the actual text.

A tenant wants to move out 90 days early because of a new job in another city. List, in order, every condition from §7 that must ALL be true before the lease is actually terminated — is giving 60 days' notice, by itself, enough?
